about_the_game:
Understand in 3 minutes, addicted for 100 hours!

What if a simple 8x8 puzzle had Balatro-level scaling? Build your engine, trigger synergies, and push your damage BEYOND 1,000,000.

Basics

  • Complete lines to attack enemies.

  • Different block types give your attacks unique power and effects.

  • Purchase relics in the Shop and activate them to boost your damage.

  • Discover block and relic synergies to unleash massive damage!

Relics

  • Relics activate when conditions are met.

  • Relic conditions vary - from simple actions like placing a block or clearing two block types at once, to tougher challenges like clearing four types or clearing both a row and a column at the same time.

    Harder conditions grant more powerful effects.

  • Collect multiple relics that activate under the same conditions, or combine different effects to create powerful synergies - like pairing a relic that grants coins with one where spending coins boosts damage.

    Build your own strategy from countless combinations and defeat tough enemies.

Other Features

  • Challenging yet rewarding bosses with unique skills that make each battle a fun puzzle to solve.

  • Trade your Max HP for powerful relics found in a secret shop.

  • Build your deck by adding, upgrading, removing, and enhancing blocks with various Factors.

  • Universe Blocks that break the basic 8×8 rules.

  • Food that grants perks to improve your run.

  • Various items that can turn the tide of battle.

    ...and much more to discover in Lapistasia.

Wishlist now and stay tuned for the release!

Craft ultimate synergies with relics to trigger explosive chain reactions. Break the rules and build the perfect combo. Can you hit 1,000,000+ damage?
